# c-testsuite parse differential: files that do NOT yet agree with gcc.
# Format: <file>  <ledger-id>  <reason>
# XPASS is a failure: if a file starts agreeing, delete its line.
#
# XD-S10-BUILTIN — the program includes <stdarg.h> or names a
#   __builtin_*; the builtins land in Sprint 28 and the deferral
#   hard-errors naming it.
# XD-S10-GNUEXT  — a GNU extension deferred to Sprint 55 (statement
#   expressions, __attribute__, typeof).
# XD-S12-SIZEOF — RETIRED in Sprint 15: sizeof in a constant expression
#   folds now (Sprint 14 gave it layout, Sprint 15 the evaluator), so the
#   file that needed it agrees with gcc and its entry is gone.
#
00206.c  XD-S10-BUILTIN  '__builtin_va_list' is not yet supported (the compiler builtins land in Sprint 28)
00210.c  XD-S10-GNUEXT  GNU '__attribute__' is not yet supported (lands in Sprint 55)
00213.c  XD-S10-GNUEXT  GNU statement expressions are not yet supported (lands in Sprint 55)
00214.c  XD-S10-BUILTIN  '__builtin_expect' is not yet supported (the compiler builtins land in Sprint 28)
00216.c  XD-S10-BUILTIN  '__builtin_va_list' is not yet supported (the compiler builtins land in Sprint 28)
00219.c  XD-S10-BUILTIN  '__builtin_va_list' is not yet supported (the compiler builtins land in Sprint 28)
